title: azalea rosmarinifolia var. alba
intro: Azalea rosmarinifolia var. alba, commonly known as the white rose azalea, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is known for its therapeutic and medicinal properties, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and alleviating symptoms of insomnia and depression. The bioactive constituents of Azalea rosmarinifolia var. alba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the mind and body, improve mood, and boost the immune system.
